name: meaning
quote: I know where I belong and what I'm supposed to do.
description: A sense of certainty that your life situation is closely aligned with your important values.
perceptions: I know where I belong and what I'm supposed to do.

guidance.description: If you've found meaning, congratulations. If you're still looking for meaning, consider the guidance in 'desire for meaning'.

examples: Volunteering for a cause you care about.

variations.name: everyday meaning
variations.description: Finding satisfaction in your family, friends, job, and/or hobbies.
perceptions: I know where I belong and what I'm supposed to do.
The normal things are good for me.

guidance.description: Three Steps for Finding Purpose in the Everyday

commentaries.quote: Don't undervalue the sense of value you can get from doing many small things well. Even jobs that seem unimportant can be fulfilling. Raising kids is a life accomplishment. Long-term friends are a treasure.

We can discover this meaning in life in three different ways: (1) by creating a work or doing a deed; (2) by experiencing something or encountering someone; and (3) by the attitude we take toward unavoidable suffering.
Happiness is GeneticBaseline + Conditions + Work + Love + SenseOfLargerPurpose
Both sides of the war find meaning in battle.
